_doc: Stamina rules every fighter shares (each fighter's own max, regen and guard drain stay in data/creatures/<id>.json). A dodge (dash) costs dodge_cost_share of the fighter's max stamina, or its own share from dodge_cost_share_by_fighter (an id and a share, such as digby 0.4, for a cheaper dash). A dodge that cancels the fighter's own attack (pressed while attacking: out of a string, during a windup, or to skip a whiffed move's recovery) costs dodge_cancel_cost_mult x that, or dodge_cancel_connected_mult x that when the move is a light that connected on this use (hit or blocked; a whiff does not count) and the fighter's role is in dodge_cancel_refund_roles (a jab and out for fighters, tanks and bruisers; heavies, skills and Surges keep the dearer price for everyone); a blocked third light can't be left this way. A blocked hit drains damage x guard.drain_per_damage x block_drain_mult[the move's type] stamina and no health (no chip). A blocked hit pauses regen for block_regen_pause_seconds, restarted by every blocked hit. At 0 stamina (from a dodge or a blocked hit) the fighter is exhausted: it can't start a guard, a held guard drops and the hit that emptied it lands clean (no extra stun), and regen waits exhaust_delay_seconds (instead of the block pause, not on top of it); for the first exhaust_slow_seconds of that it walks at exhaust_speed_mult of its speed.
_cc_doc: cc_through_guard: the crowd control a blocked hit still lands in full (the guard only stops the damage): slow (slow_ticks), root (root_ticks), blind (blind_ticks), freeze (freeze_ticks), petrify, launch, knockdown, crumple, pull and stagger (a stagger_if mark that pays off). A launch, knockdown, crumple, freeze, petrify or stagger drops the guard. Remove a kind to block it again; leaving the key out means all of them. Plain hitstun, poison, vuln and steal stay blocked.
